notesDetails.title: Why S7 Failed Holdout (6/7 vs. 7/7 Claimed): System.trap_signal(:sigterm, ...) Left OTP's :erl_signal_handler Active, Killing >1s In-Flight Requests With Exit 0 & No Summary
bullets: Root Cause at Line 406 (`:erl_signal_handler` Left Installed Alongside `System.trap_signal(:sigterm, ...)`): The `./cb` launcher runs `cb.escript` with `emu_args: "+B i"` and forwards terminal `Ctrl-C` via `trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null' INT TERM`. Inside `CapyBench.Runner.run/1`, `System.trap_signal(:sigterm, :capy_bench, ...)` adds `{System.SignalHandler, {:sigterm, :capy_bench}}` to `:erl_signal_server` **without** removing OTP's default `:erl_signal_handler`. When `SIGTERM` arrives, `:erl_signal_handler` still fires `:init.stop()` in the background, shutting down the VM ~1.0s later with exit code `0`. At Line 405–406, the agent saw `"SIGTERM received - shutting down"` on stderr and raised `:logger` level to `:warning` in `lib/capy_bench/cli.ex` to silence the notice rather than removing `:erl_signal_handler` or switching to `:sigusr2`.

Empirical Holdout PTY Probes Confirm Post-Boot S7 Failure on 1.0s–2.0s In-Flight Requests: Because fast targets (`~300ms` live `https://rizafahmi.com`, `500ms` pacing, and the agent's own `800ms` server in `test/capy_bench/interrupt_test.exs`) settle in `< 1.0s`, they beat `:init.stop()` and cleanly print a partial summary with exit `130`. However, any in-flight request taking `1.0s–2.0s` (still within the 2s timeout contract) loses the race to `:init.stop()`: foreground PTY `Ctrl-C` at `0.4s` against a `1.5s` server exited `0` at `1.44s` with empty stdout, and `Ctrl-C` at `0.8s` and `1.2s` against a `3.5s` stalled server exited `0` at `1.82s` and `2.25s` with no summary (`1.5s` `Ctrl-C` only succeeded with exit `130` at `2.26s` because the 2s HTTP timeout fired `0.76s < 1.0s` later). Like other unguarded shell wrappers, pressing `Ctrl-C` during the initial ~200 ms BEAM boot window also fails (`50ms` → exit `143`; `150ms` → exit `127` with `escript: exception exit: terminating`).

notesDetails.title: Live HTTPS Fixed vs. Pi deepseek-flash (13/13 HTTP 200 on https://rizafahmi.com), 29 Inline Python File Patches & Pipeline-Masked Bash Telemetry
bullets: Clean Live HTTPS & System CA Verification (Fixing Pi `deepseek-flash`'s Bug): Unlike `pi-deepseek-flash-high` (which accidentally wiped all 160 macOS system CA certs via `normalize_cacerts/1`), `lib/capy_bench/http.ex` (439 LoC over raw `:gen_tcp`/`:ssl`) properly extracts DER binaries from OTP 28's `:public_key.cacerts_get()` and verifies hostnames via `:public_key.pkix_verify_hostname_match_fun(:https)`. Live `./cb https://rizafahmi.com` passed cleanly (`rc=0`, empty stderr, `13/13` HTTP `200`, `0` transport failures, `p50 309 ms, p95 754 ms`, fresh TCP/TLS connection per request), and `./cb http://rizafahmi.com` passed with `46/46` HTTP `301` (`p50 96 ms, p95 148 ms`).

Zero `read` Tool Calls & 29 Inline `python3` File Patches: Despite having `read` available, the agent issued `0` `read` calls (relying on `omp`'s initial `@AGENTS.md`/`@PLAN.md` file mentions plus `cat`/`sed`/`nl` in `bash`) and used `29` inline `python3 - <<'PY'` `open().read().replace()` scripts in `bash` (Lines 165–473) alongside `29` `write` and `19` `edit` calls (`0` edit errors).

Audit of `1` Reported `isError` vs. `23` Pipeline-Masked Non-Zero Subcommands: `omp` recorded only `1` tool error (`isError: true` at Line 39, probing `os:set_signal(sigint, handle)` / `default` which raised `badarg` and wrote `erl_crash.dump`, cleaned at Line 96). However, because the agent piped `mix test` and `mix credo` through `2>&1 | tail -N` without `pipefail`, `tail` returned exit `0` and masked `23` additional non-zero subcommands captured in `omp v19.0.0`'s `details.trace`: `13` failing `mix test` runs (`S3` Lines 188, 191, 212; `S4` Lines 264, 270, 300; `S6` Lines 370, 373; `S7` Lines 402, 405, 408, 417, 420 including a Python double-escaped `\\d` regex bug in `interrupt_test.exs`), `4` `mix credo --strict` catches (`Lines 131, 223, 309, 437`), and `6` benign reconnaissance probes (`Lines 33, 44, 49, 95, 155, 279`).
